DATA HANDLING POLICY
This policy sets out how the authority classifies and handles information.

1. CLASSIFICATION
All information held by the authority must be classified according to its sensitivity and the applicable statutory exemptions before any decision to release or withhold is made.

2. PERSONAL DATA
Personal data must be handled in compliance with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Staff must not disclose personal data of third parties in response to FOI requests where the disclosure would breach data protection principles.

3. COMMERCIAL DATA
Commercial and contractual information must be reviewed against Section 43 before release. Where a supplier has indicated that information is commercially sensitive, the authority must conduct a public interest test to determine whether the public interest in disclosure outweighs the interest in maintaining confidentiality.
